hash_policy: hash equality/difference is supporting evidence only; never sufficient proof of copy or rebuild

LAB-A.rule: LAB-A declares leaf_build_claim.status=not_applicable; invented compiler/output fields are REJECTED

LAB-B.rule: LAB-B leaf_build_claim is a CLAIM ONLY (sources/commands/outputs); the controller demonstrates or rejects it by controlled rebuild

policy: controller IGNORES binaries generated by the leaf when verifying provenance
controller creates an EMPTY build dir and recompiles from canonical sources
capture compiler path (realpath), compiler --version, environment allow-list, source blob SHAs, source sha256, timestamps
output stat + output sha256 + ELF metadata + dynamic dependencies captured
controller executes acceptance tests with the FRESHLY BUILT outputs
any ELF tracked in a result commit -> REJECT
hash equality with quarantine is NEVER used alone as proof of copy or of rebuild
forbidden: synthetic JSON output, constant hash, mock executable, quarantine copies, failed-worktree copies, leaf binaries as controller evidence
